name: Dumbbell Hip Thrust
cues: Sit against the bench and rest one dumbbell across your hip crease
Hold the ends so it stays put as you lift
Drive your heels down until your hips, shoulders and knees line up
Keep your chin tucked and ribs down at the top

qa.note: Wave 3a 2026-10-08: rated ok by the lane review, auto-approved. ok: Hip -4 to 74 flex, knee 91 to 111, feet planted. The dumbbell sits across the hip crease (6 mm rest), palms on the end faces, wrists extended 35 to 42. It looks large in the hero, but a 24 kg head of about 17 cm diameter is realistic.
